Peter, I hope you’re enjoying your Labor Day weekend! After this is when things really kick into high gear for a competitive campaign like ours. In one month, ballots drop. That means more doors, more calls, more of everything – and less time to reach the voters who haven't made up their mind yet. Every week between now and then counts double. It also means yard signs. I know they can seem like a small thing next to everything else a campaign does, but they work. A sign in a yard is the quiet reminder that shows up on every commute, every dog walk, every drive to the grocery store. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138638781/644698487/954579451?refcode=em-9.5.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZDcyYzdlOC00MmE5LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XYxN095zxekgg9AVmSbn9ybWvaX__y3fPXh0UAoCkYM=) That matters even more this cycle. Under Prop 50, we've got thousands of new voters in CA-27 who've never had the chance to vote for me before. And that could change the fight for the entire Senate.

* [**00:03:31**] We dig into the staggering list of Paxton scandals--and why Democrats finally have an opening to make them stick.

name: David Hogg
subject: Do these emails annoy you, Peter?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I’ll stop sending these emails when we win the power to not need them anymore.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260905-1&t=1&akid=3969%2E587540%2E12IMBR)
Hey Peter, David here.
Yes. This is _another_ political fundraising email.
And no, I’m not sitting here thinking, _“Yay! We get to send Peter another email!”_
I know these can feel overwhelming. So the fact that you actually open these emails, read them, and when you’re able to, you even chip in a few dollars? That means the world to me.
Because right now, **emails like these are one of the only real tools we have to raise the resources needed to build the next generation of progressive leadership.**
We don't have corporate PACs. We don’t have lobbyists. We don’t have the Democratic Party machine backing us.
But we have _you._ We have _people_. And sometimes that means we show up in your inbox more than either of us would prefer.
But I promise you this, Peter:
**The day young progressive leaders finally have a real seat at the table, these emails _stop_.** The day we aren’t fighting uphill for representation and change? I will _gladly_ stop emailing you. Honestly, my hope is that one day our candidates reform the campaign finance system enough that elections are won by who the best organizer is, not who can raise the most money.
But we’re not there yet. And until we are, we have work to do — and we simply can’t do it without grassroots support from people like you.
We’re solving the chicken-and-egg problem that keeps our political system so broken. The problem being that if we are going to change laws, we need morally just leaders who don’t take corporate money. The other problem, though, is that it’s very hard to build power without taking money from special interests like private utilities or big pharma.
That’s where you come in. We need thousands of small-dollar donors to help grow the power of our candidates so they can take on those special interests without taking money from them.
We’re up against entrenched, powerful interests designed to keep things exactly as they are. Electing bold, young progressives who want to _actually change things_? That makes a lot of powerful people _really_ uncomfortable. And that’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists and why we’re so powerful.
And your support fuels this fight. And yes, sometimes that means more emails than you might like. It’s not because we expect you to give every time — but because when you can, _it matters_. **The ripple effect is real. A thousand small actions add up to generational change.**
So Peter, if you’re in a position to do so today, we’d be grateful.
**[Chip in $5 to help us build the future we deserve.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260905_1_send.JEabcH&refcode=em20260905-3969&amount=5&t=2&akid=3969%2E587540%2E12IMBR)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260905_1_send.JEabcH&amount=5&refcode=em20260905-3969&t=21&akid=3969%2E587540%2E12IMBR)**
One day, when we win the power we’re building towards, your inbox will be a _lot_ quieter.
And our future will be a _lot_ better.
Thank you for your support.
— David Hogg

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: sorry to interrupt
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
I know it’s a long weekend, but I’d really appreciate it if you gave this message a quick read.

Hey Derek, I know it’s a long weekend, but I’d really appreciate it if you gave this message a quick read. The fact is, fewer than 20% of people who receive these emails actually open them — and that’s on a good day. And on a Saturday like today, where most folks aren’t checking their inbox? this? A federal appeals court ruled that Sigal Chattah, one of Trump’s
crony nominees, has been illegally running the U.S. Attorney's office in
Nevada.

Not "controversially." Not "questionably." Illegally.^1

For over a year, Chattah — a Trump loyalist and former Nevada GOP official
— held one of the most powerful law enforcement jobs in the state without
ever being confirmed by the Senate, thanks to a legal shell game: expire
one appointment, invent a new title, repeat.

Here's why that matters. While Chattah illegally occupied that office, she
used it to push Trump's retribution campaign against his political enemies
— and pressured the FBI to chase already-debunked election-fraud theories.

Courts have struck down Trump loyalists installed the same way in other
states. But striking an appointment doesn't undo a year of political
prosecutions and a Justice Department bent toward one man's enemies list.

Trump doesn't care whether his people are qualified or lawfully appointed
— he cares whether they're loyal to him instead of the Constitution, and
he's not going to stop.

Demand Justice exists to hold him and every one of his nominees
accountable. That means tracking every illegal appointment like Chattah's
and pressuring senators who are supposed to be a check on this, not a
rubber stamp.

| | Dear Friend,
There is an unholy alliance forming in America that should not be possible.
**On one side stand revolutionary socialists who believe there is no God at all** – and that America will not be free until every trace of its Judeo-Christian foundation is scrubbed out of our schools, our courts, and our public life.
**On the other stand political Islamists who believe their god must rule** every one of those things absolutely, and that no other faith has any rightful claim to exist beside it.
They disagree about the most fundamental question a human being can ask – _and yet they have found each other._
**Because they have found the same enemy.**
That enemy is not a political party. It is not a candidate. **It is the Christian faith** – the last thing standing between both of these movements and the world they intend to build.

President Trump named the first threat plainly:
"These ruthless communists will attack all religions, but in particular Christianity. They always do. They're after Christianity more than any other religion."
He is right, and history proves it. Every communist revolution of the last century began by locking the church doors. In China, _Pastor Ezra Jin spent 266 days in prison_ for leading one of the country's largest underground churches. Eight of his fellow pastors are still behind bars. In North Korea, _owning a Bible can cost you the rest of your life in a labor camp._
Secretary of State Marco Rubio named the second:
"Radical Islam isn't content with controlling a single region or establishing a small caliphate. Its ideology is revolutionary. It aims to grow, to dominate, and to exert control over more lands and more populations."
That is the whole project of political Islam: **placing religious power above every constitution, every court, and every conscience. **There is no room left in it for religious liberty. No room for a man to read the Gospel and decide for himself that it is true.
And if you want to know what that project does to a man who decides exactly that, consider Nissar Hussain.

Nissar left Islam and gave his life to Jesus Christ. For that, he spent seventeen years being hunted. Not in Tehran. Not in Nigeria. _In Bradford, England._
His kneecap was shattered in an attack outside his own home. His car was set on fire. His children were taunted in the street as "infidels." His family lived under police protection for nearly a decade.
_Not one bishop of the Church of England stood with him._
Nissar's "crime" carries a death sentence in eleven nations on this earth.
Now look at what happens where this ideology governs without restraint.
**In Nigeria, more than 100,000 Christians have been massacred since 2009. 19,000 churches burned or destroyed. Five million men, women, and children driven from their homes. **
This is not history. _It is now._
Just before midnight on July 26, militants entered the village of Naridon and went house to house, shooting. **Thirty Christians were killed. Eleven were children. The youngest was three years old.**
On August 1, thousands gathered for a single funeral Mass. _Twenty-seven caskets._
That is not a distant tragedy. That is the destination.
**And that ideology now has political sponsorship inside the United States – with a partner supplying it lawyers, funding, and votes.**
**Start in Dearborn, Michigan.**
Pastor Lorenzo Sewell prayed at President Trump's inauguration. Today he says Christians there come to him quietly, from every corner of the city, with the same message: "I'm with you, but I'm afraid to say it."
**Afraid to say they follow Christ.** _**In America.** _
Sewell describes a city where the call to prayer is broadcast over loudspeakers, where the public schools certify that every ounce of meat served to children is prepared according to Islamic ritual law, and where his own wife's life was threatened – the man's name and address handed to police – and nothing happened.
"Think about being in a Christian nation," he said, "being afraid to talk about Christ."
**Then look at our schools.**
At two of the top public high schools in Virginia, students filmed promotional videos for their Muslim student clubs showing classmates hooded, dragged away, and thrown into car trunks – weeks after the anniversary of the October 7th massacre. The district disciplined them. Congress opened an investigation. And then a national Islamic advocacy group hauled the school system into federal court, _arguing that punishing the students was itself discrimination._
The provocation comes from one side. The lawyers come from the other.
**Then look at New York City.**
_The largest city in America is now run by a self-described Democratic Socialist who took his oath of office on the Quran_ – elected with six figures of help from a network of Islamist organizations, including one whose leaders have been tied to terror-financing investigations. It's why he can visit a mosque in the morning and march in an LGBTQ parade that afternoon.
The socialists supply the political machine and the moral cover. The Islamists supply the ideology and the money. Neither could do this alone. _Together, they are formidable. _
**"If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first."** – John 15:18
Jesus told us this would come. He did not tell us to be silent about it.
**This is precisely why Save the Persecuted Christians exists. We guide a coalition of over 200 organizations fighting this battle on both fronts at once – because they are the same battle.**
✅ We brought Nissar Hussain to America and put him before members of Congress.
✅ We helped drive the campaign to redesignate Nigeria a "Country of Particular Concern," laying the groundwork for real sanctions and accountability.
✅ Our educational efforts helped fuel the 95% vote by Texas Republicans to prohibit Sharia law – and the launch of the Sharia-Free America Caucus, now 60 members strong across 25 states.
**388 million Christians** – _**one in every seven believers on earth** _ – **live under threat right now for the same faith you are free to practice openly this morning.**
That freedom is not a possession. _**It is a responsibility.** _

Hi Peter, I want to tell you about a phone call that changed how I approached this job. When I won my first election to Congress, one of the first calls I got was from Senator Dick Durbin. He told me he wanted to give me the same advice he once gave a young Senator named Barack Obama back in 2005: **“There's only a short window between Election Day and being sworn in, and the smartest thing you can do with it is make friends with the incoming freshmen across the aisle. ** **“Once the politics of reelection kick in, it gets a lot harder to build those relationships.”** So I took his advice. Every morning during freshman orientation, before the sun came up, I showed up for breakfast with incoming Republican members. A lot of them had never met a weatherman turned Congressman before, and honestly, neither had I met most of them. Surely enough, those early mornings built those bridges. I don't agree with most of my Republican colleagues on the big things, and I will always fight them on those. But because of that time, I've built relationships I can call on when we can actually find common ground and get something done for the people we represent. With Senator Durbin retiring, I've been thinking a lot about how much that one piece of advice has shaped my time in Congress. It's part of why I've been able to work across the aisle even in a Congress that often rewards the opposite. **There will only be one Dick Durbin, and I'm grateful every day that he believed in me from the start.** I plan on passing that same advice along to the next class of freshmen, in the 120th Congress and beyond, if the voters of IL-17 give me that chance again. I don't agree with most of my Republican colleagues on the big things, and I will always fight them on those. But because of that time, I've built relationships I can call on when we can actually find common ground and get something done for the people we represent. With Senator Durbin retiring, I've been thinking a lot about how much that one piece of advice has shaped my time in Congress. It's part of why I've been able to work across the aisle even in a Congress that often rewards the opposite. There will only be one Dick Durbin, and I'm grateful every day that he believed in me from the start. I plan on passing that same advice along to the next class of freshmen, in the 120th Congress and beyond, if the voters of IL-17 give me that chance again. = | | | = Thank you, -Eric = | Eric Sorensen is a meteorologist born and raised in Rockford, IL representing IL-17 in Congress. He’s seen firsthand the importance of establishing trust with the community, and he’s determined to use his expertise as a climate communicator to fight for Illinoisans on environmental justice and more in Washington. Welcome, fellow citizens, to a masterclass in Illinois municipal finance--specifically, the Tiffany Aiesha Henyard Method (C). For four glorious years (2021-2025), Mayor Henyard of Dolton and Supervisor Henyard of Thornton Township proved that holding two elected offices simultaneously is not just a conflict of interest--it's a lifestyle.
**The Budget: A Mere Suggestion**
Most politicians treat public budgets with sober reverence. Henyard treated Dolton's coffers like an all-you-can-eat buffet with no closing time. Under her stewardship, the village of roughly 20,000 residents managed to dig itself a hole exceeding $3.5 million. But who's counting? Certainly not the first responders operating on shoestring budgets while City Hall apparently browsed Amazon Prime.
Speaking of Amazon: have you ever impulse-bought $43,000 worth of goodies in a single day? No? Then congratulations--you have more self-control than the Village of Dolton under Henyard, where a single day of online shopping reportedly cost taxpayers north of forty grand. One can only assume free two-day shipping was involved

Peter, Every student deserves to have someone at school they can turn to when they are struggling. But while Washington families are counting on schools to support their kids, Trump’s administration tried to pull the plug on the federal funding that helps put counselors and mental health professionals in those schools. In Washington, those cuts could have meant losing an estimated **$20 million in mental health services for public school students.** Nationwide, these programs were created to bring 14,000 mental health professionals into schools that need them most. In their first year, they provided services to nearly 775,000 students. **Trump tried to take that support away. We refused to let him.** I led a coalition of 15 state attorneys general in challenging the administration’s attempt to terminate these grants. Washington has now won six favorable rulings protecting this funding. Kids should not have to pay the price for Trump’s reckless cuts. When this administration targets programs that Washington families rely on, I will keep standing up and fighting back. **[When Trump threatens our children, I won’t back down. clean_body: Students, families, and teachers all feel the impact when school mental-health programs lose funding. | Peter, Every student deserves to have someone at school they can turn to when they are struggling. But while Washington families are counting on schools to support their kids, Trump’s administration tried to pull the plug on the federal funding that helps put counselors and mental health professionals in those schools. In Washington, those cuts could have meant losing an estimated $20 million in mental health services for public school students. Nationwide, these programs were created to bring 14,000 mental health professionals into schools that need them most. In their first year, they provided services to nearly 775,000 students. Trump tried to take that support away. We refused to let him. I led a coalition of 15 state attorneys general in challenging the administration’s attempt to terminate these grants. Washington has now won six favorable rulings protecting this funding. Kids should not have to pay the price for Trump’s reckless cuts. Liberal ideology has had horrific effects on our society. The Lindsay Clancy trial is the result of feminism, the popularity of Hasan Piker is the result of socialism, and the persistence of trans athletes in women's sports is the result of perverted gender ideology. But where did all of this insanity come from?
How did we get here?
A huge reason why we are currently caught in a cultural crisis is due to the liberal takeover of colleges. Young America's Foundation recently published a report, aptly titled "Comedy & Tragedy," outlining some of the most progressive classes currently available at major colleges. As YAF Representative Rob Tandy told _The Capitalist,_ "The report exposes what ideas students are being exposed to. There's a lot of classes being taught on Marxism, gender ideology, and race... We're trying to reveal what's really being taught in college classrooms, behind closed doors."
Schools are coaxing students into paying nearly $10,000 for pro-Marxist classes that sound more like _SNL_ sketches than serious studies. The report outlines endless avant-garde courses, from "Rainbow Cowboys", which explores gender and sexuality in Westerns, to a seminar on Bad Bunny, studying the "Latinx artist" in relation to "empire, gender, and queerness."

# **New likely candidate for Trump 's next Press Secretary emerges**
Fox Corp. **[announced Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/766c9fbf-f516-40a4-b25d-9d85d1e82c04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that Maria Bartiromo, who hosted "Mornings with Maria," "Maria Bartiromo's Wall Street," and "Sunday Morning Futures" for over 12 years has departed from the network.
Her attorneys dispute claims that she was fired.
Now she has entered the pool of likely replacements for Karoline Leavitt as White House Press Secretary, with **[Kalshi odds currently at 14%](https://substack.com/redirect/eee3c168-dc6f-4b1a-af01-ab4fdaff5a9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** she will assume the role.

* * *
* * *
American universities are charging students thousands and thousands of dollars to take radical, woke classes. The average cost of tuition at top American Universities has continued to explode, typically **[ranging](https://substack.com/redirect/4ce3b680-337a-4fff-ad1d-8a6a3494b94a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from $85,000-$95,000 per semester during the 2025-2026 school year. Simultaneously, the quality of the classes offered at schools like Harvard, Columbia, and UPenn have become laughable.
At Princeton, a three credit-hour course costs just shy of $6,000. For their money, students can take classes such as "Marx in the 21st Century," "Latinx Feminisms and Queer Interventions for Saving the World," and "Criminalizing Immigrants: From Border Patrol to Mass Incarceration." Students looking to major in African American Studies can take a class entitled "Black Latinidad: from Frederick Douglass to Cardi B." Cardi B is an ex-stripper who claimed she used to drug men and rob them, but here she is being heralded as a historic cultural hero. Architecture students can take a class called "Designing Reparations," where they study the works of radical black activists such as Angela Y. Davis, the Marxist feminist. The class teaches students that "reparations are a matter of design," and that there is a direct link between "urbanism, planetary climate crisis, [and] postcolonialism."
At UPenn, a three credit-hour course costs $5,088. For that price, students can take classes such as "Extreme Heat: White Nationalism in the Age of Climate Change," which asks students to consider the connections between environmentalism, right wing nationalist movements, and the climate crisis. They can also take a course in "Decolonizing French Food," which dives into how colonialism is responsible for peoples' perception of French food being limited to baguettes and croissants, while "employing theoretical tools" such as "feminist and gender studies, critical race studies, and postcolonial studies."

Tandy told _The Capitalist_ that he has a hard time picking which class he finds the most absurd, simply because there are so many. "The underlying issue we have with these courses is that they're promoting a dark ideology. We've been publishing this report since 1995... The overwhelming liberal bias hasn't changed."
Although there are hundreds of radical classes listed in the report, covering all aspects of racial inequality, queer thought, feminism, and communism, there are a few notable highlights we would be remiss not to point out. Those include:
* Wellesley College's $6,000 class on "Gender and Race in Westerns: Rainbow Cowboys (and Girls)"
* Barnard College's $6,408 class on "Queer Caribbean Critique"
* University of Illinois' $1,803 class on "Black Dances of Resistance"
* University of Minnesota's $3,972 class on "Wakanda & Black Liberatory Futures" (Wakanda is a fictional African country from Marvel Comics)
* UCLA's $4,261 class on "Trans Theater and Performance"
* University of Georgia's $8,727 class on "Bodies, Gender, Sexuality and Sex Education **for Children and Youth** "
* University of Kentucky's $4,008 class on "Diversity and Society in Video Games"
* University of Oklahoma's $2,214 class on "Gender and James Bond"
* UC Berkeley's $4,261 class on "Post-Apocalyptic Botany"
* University of Miami's $7,263 class on "Is Star Wars a Religion?"
* Syracuse University's $8,007 class on "Queering the Middle Ages"
* Bowdoin College's $3,768 class on "Jindar Justice: Gender and Sexual Activism in Arab-Majority Societies"
* Texas State University's $2,181 class on "Jesus and Gender"

The big takeaway? Maybe think twice before letting your kids take out hundreds of thousands of dollars in debt to attend college.

# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=834%2E127862%2EaSAuEt)
Folks, here’s the biggest difference between Joe Lombardo and me:
MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo spends his time fighting for billionaires and data center developers. **I spend my time fighting for Nevada**
While Nevadans are struggling due to the failing Lombardo-Trump economy, Lombardo's been handing out sweetheart deals to giant data centers and special interests.
Lombardo’s actions couldn’t be more out of step with the leadership working families actually need right now.
As your Attorney General, I've sued corporate price-gougers, taken on big drug companies, and stood up to Trump. **I’ll take this fight to the next level as governor, but I can’t get there without your support.**
Folks, this is the only Republican-held incumbent governor's seat in the country rated a toss-up, and Lombardo's billionaire backers know it. That's why they're already spending big to keep things exactly the way they are.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Socialism is knocking at the door. Will our children let it in?
As a father and grandfather, there is nothing I care more about than preserving our nation’s founding principles, so that my grandchildren—and all future generations—will have the freedom and opportunity to achieve the American Dream.
But if we want _them_ to preserve that dream, we must first teach them what makes America exceptional, how our freedoms were secured, and why they are worth defending. This is why in the Texas House, I fought passionately to pass legislation that banned the hateful tenets of Critical Race Theory from our classrooms, strengthened parental rights, expanded educational resources for students with dyslexia, banned the practice of social transitioning in public schools, and eliminated the CSOPE curriculum that taught Texas students that the men who flew the planes on 9/11 were “freedom fighters” while the people in Boston who opposed the Tea Act of 1773 were “domestic terrorists”.
Because as Ronald Reagan said, _"Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.”_

When I got off active duty and came back home to the great state of Georgia, I quickly realized that despite having thousands of service members in our communities, **_Georgia is not a veteran-friendly state,_** between state taxes on military retirement and a healthcare system that treats veterans like an afterthought.
---
| [ ](http://clicksp.shawnharrisforcongress.com/f/a/a1ao9wzy3iSyZTjluEQx4Q~~/AAPPABA~/NYC2XX3erid72w_XX9ZNBSuwyDrV4vAP40PLlwDLwKBn0MO-OUuJQ4FR-jv4uRWXRi0w1ZFM6nFsnfAbneGSEM0u7zgtuW9DRCDNRnxTb0sM_IIHGeSTcHFS6i0m9ynRMa6g-oaTYYu9P8RRAgd3ThgiekTCQdpS9o_uSun4C4gBjxMMaW71C5W-u04sXCL9rHtUi0Ud_Scazd52OPBJBy5LnVSHPwCqOGi6p0KBZukKxEwZ6HVmkQkbyitF4S8wlchkTWZ8qWGATnmLQ1KhzMpQmkOeEfzCjaIIcLy9XpeeaYLPB8gpHqOnSL491qM3)
---
My last assignment was in Israel. I went from leading troops in high-stakes environments to coming back home and experiencing the sudden crash that so many service members face when transitioning back to civilian life. I knew I needed help, so I called Fort Benning. They directed me to a local mental health facility. I pulled up to that clinic as General Shawn Harris. I walked to the counter, and the receptionist looked right at me and said: _"We don't take TRICARE anymore."_ I had served 40 years. I had the rank, and I had the phone numbers to call people high up in the chain of command to fix my situation. But what if I was an E-4? If a young Specialist walked into that clinic without a star on their shoulder or a direct line to a general, they would have been turned away with nowhere to go. Without help, they could have ended up dead. I walked back out, sat in my car, and thought: **_This is why I 'm getting into politics._** **My blood boils when politicians like Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth treat our military like a political backdrop or talk about veterans' benefits as something to slash and privatize.** Pete Hegseth and the political class in Washington love to wrap themselves in the flag, but when our service members come home broken, struggling, or needing care, they look the other way. They treat the men and women who put their lives on the line like line items on a spreadsheet instead of human beings who earned their care. Our troops and veterans don't need political posturing or lectures on culture wars from political appointees--they need a healthcare system that actually answers the phone when they call for help. I fought for this country for four decades, and I'm not going to sit quietly while politicians neglect the men and women who served alongside me. body:
Let’s take back what belongs to us.
| Friend, this is Adam Schiff.

Investigators in my office uncovered the contracts behind the banners of Donald Trump's face now hanging on federal buildings across Washington — the largest of them eight stories tall at the Department of Health and Human Services, with "America First" printed beside it: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/128792?t=6&akid=28502%2E878179%2ESKUBnv) | [ DONATE TO FIGHT BACK » ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/128792?t=7&akid=28502%2E878179%2ESKUBnv)
---
Here’s what we uncovered:

The American people paid for every inch of it, and we have the receipts. $114,000 from the FAA. $39,000 from Interior. A third check from the Labor Department.

The list goes on and on.

**Congress long ago outlawed spending taxpayer dollars on propaganda and self-aggrandizement, and an eight-story-high Donald Trump head certainly qualifies.**

Because I spent years as a federal prosecutor, and I know a pattern of intent when I see one. In every country where democracy gave way to one man, the faces went up on the government buildings first. Not as decoration, and not even as vanity — but to teach the people who paid for those buildings a simple lesson: _all of this belongs to him now._

And yet not one of those buildings belongs to Donald Trump. They belong to the American people, to the taxpayers who funded them. We were never asked, and we do not have to accept it.

There is one check on this president that he cannot fire and cannot intimidate: a Democratic Senate, with the gavels and subpoena power to hold him to account.

[ Will you chip in $10, split between the Voter Protection Project and me, to help us take back the Senate and take back what belongs to all of us? ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/128792?t=8&akid=28502%2E878179%2ESKUBnv)

We're fighting to flip the seats that will decide the majority, because the evidence we uncover only matters if we win the power to act on it.

Thank you,

— Adam

That we can deal with the climate crisis in four years, after the next election, or when the right leader comes along. **But a better _tomorrow_ depends on what we do today.** As you read this message, the Trump administration is relentlessly rolling back environmental protections — fast-tracking drilling and mining, denying climate science, and handing out tax giveaways to some of our country’s biggest polluters. Some of these attacks have caused irreparable damage, and I refuse to sit by while Trump and his polluter buddies do even more. **We simply can’t wait until the next election for change.** But we can’t settle for just voting out Republicans. Back in February, I demanded answers from USPS about what this administration was doing to mail ballots ahead of the midterms.
In April, I told the Postmaster General to reject Trump's executive order outright.
In July, I got 169 of my colleagues to join me in that call.
**This week, a federal whistleblower confirmed exactly what I've been warning about — a rushed, chaotic ballot-verification system that could leave millions of Americans without a working ballot this November. In their words: "secretive, rushed, chaotic, and fundamentally flawed."**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138645283/644720161/789508428?refcode=260905_RG_usps-whistleblower&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODRmMmRiOC01MWE5LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTkzM2IiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YgCOBTFQR-wyq9MFccveQf4eaXH_ue62Wk54VLGzE3Y=)

I'll say it again now: this was never about "election integrity." **It's about deciding, in advance, who gets to vote and who doesn't — and betting that Americans won't notice until their ballot doesn't show up.**
**I am not about to watch this administration quietly take a vote away from a senior in Ohio, a veteran in Nevada, or a mom working two jobs in Long Beach who mails her ballot in because she can't take a day off to stand in line.**
We all knew these guys were trying to gut our democracy, but now we have a whistleblower to prove it — and now it's in writing, filed with a U.S. Senator, impossible to spin away.
We already forced USPS onto the defensive once this year. **We're about to do it again, louder, with less patience, and with an election just two months out.**

Through all these experiences, I've learned that **you have to keep up the fight. You can't give up.**

And that couldn't be more true than it is today. We need to stand up to Donald Trump _every single day_ as he works to undermine the values that make America great. [**Will you show me you're in this fight now by signing this petition? >>**](http://go.dscc.org/go/23356?ask=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-ND-20260905-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20260905-MartinSheen-SheenStandUpToTrump-Pros-sl1&akid=25871%2E9716520%2EnEz-lK)

Martin Sheen

subject: Our first Ground Truth bus of the year was a huge success!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Last weekend, our first Ground Truth bus of the year transported more than 40 volunteers to Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District.
#
Hi there,
**Last weekend, our first Ground Truth bus of the year transported more than 40 volunteers to Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District.**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260905-2685&t=1&akid=2685%2E1562180%2E83KSTn)
Together, they knocked on doors to help **Democrat Paige Cognetti defeat Republican Rob Bresnahan** this November and flip this critical swing district blue.
After the canvass, the energy and joy on the ride home were palpable. _Everyone_ wanted to talk and debrief about the incredible conversations they had with voters, and they’re all looking forward to joining our next canvass later this month.
One volunteer leader even said she went into the canvass as a bit of a skeptic on Ground Truth. But once it was over, she was thoroughly impressed with the strategy and was already planning ways to participate more.
If you’re not already familiar, Ground Truth is Swing Left’s innovative, volunteer-led deep canvassing program that aims to rebuild trust in Democrats by listening first. We talk to voters across the ideological spectrum, including Republicans, Independents, and waning Democrats, take notes on what we hear, and make valuable insights available to Democratic campaigns and party committees so they can refine their messaging and outreach strategies to build winning campaigns ahead of Election Day.
So far, Ground Truth volunteers have had more than 15,000 meaningful conversations with voters in swing districts and states across the country, and we’re planning to scale up exponentially before the election.
**But in order to make it happen, we’re going to need a lot more buses—and this bus program is only possible thanks to the generous support of the Swing Left community.**
We’re aiming to raise $100,000 to secure 33 buses in total before Election Day, and so far, this community has helped us raise $50,000 toward that goal. We’re halfway there, and I can’t thank you enough for making that happen.
[**If you’d like to help secure more buses and get more volunteers out to the swing districts and states that will decide the midterms, will you make a donation to the Ground Truth Bus Fund today?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260905-2685&t=2&akid=2685%2E1562180%2E83KSTn)
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260905-2685&t=3&akid=2685%2E1562180%2E83KSTn)**
With the help of this grassroots community, I’m confident that we can reach our $100,000 goal, have hundreds of thousands of conversations with voters, and make the difference for Democrats in swing races across the country this November.
Thank you again for all you do. We’ll reach out with more updates soon!
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. clean_body: Last weekend, our first Ground Truth bus of the year transported more than 40 volunteers to Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District. Hi there, Last weekend, our first Ground Truth bus of the year transported more than 40 volunteers to Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District. Together, they knocked on doors to help Democrat Paige Cognetti defeat Republican Rob Bresnahan this November and flip this critical swing district blue. After the canvass, the energy and joy on the ride home were palpable. Everyone wanted to talk and debrief about the incredible conversations they had with voters, and they’re all looking forward to joining our next canvass later this month. One volunteer leader even said she went into the canvass as a bit of a skeptic on Ground Truth. But once it was over, she was thoroughly impressed with the strategy and was already planning ways to participate more. If you’re not already familiar, Ground Truth is Swing Left’s innovative, volunteer-led deep canvassing program that aims to rebuild trust in Democrats by listening first. We talk to voters across the ideological spectrum, including Republicans, Independents, and waning Democrats, take notes on what we hear, and make valuable insights available to Democratic campaigns and party committees so they can refine their messaging and outreach strategies to build winning campaigns ahead of Election Day. So far, Ground Truth volunteers have had more than 15,000 meaningful conversations with voters in swing districts and states across the country, and we’re planning to scale up exponentially before the election. But in order to make it happen, we’re going to need a lot more buses—and this bus program is only possible thanks to the generous support of the Swing Left community. We’re aiming to raise $100,000 to secure 33 buses in total before Election Day, and so far, this community has helped us raise $50,000 toward that goal. We’re halfway there, and I can’t thank you enough for making that happen. With the help of this grassroots community, I’m confident that we can reach our $100,000 goal, have hundreds of thousands of conversations with voters, and make the difference for Democrats in swing races across the country this November. Thank you again for all you do. We’ll reach out with more updates soon! name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: What our progressive movement stands for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260905-6690-footer&t=1001&akid=6690%2E420207%2ENZe4Uy ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

We didn’t build this movement by waiting for permission.

We built it by organizing. By standing up for working people. By refusing
to accept that the status quo is the best we can do. And every victory
we’ve won together — from advancing a bold progressive agenda to holding
the line against attacks on our communities — has happened because people
like you have been willing to stand shoulder to shoulder and fight.

That is what makes this movement so powerful. They can try to divide us.
They can try to buy our silence. They can throw everything they have at
us. But they cannot stop people who are organized, determined, and willing
to fight for one another.

Every measure we’ve passed. Every Resistance Lab we’ve held. Every
Medicare For All townhall. We’ve turned outrage into action and action
into progress.

That is the power of this movement — and you are a part of it.

Over the past several months, I’ve been traveling across the country,
rallying alongside candidates, fighting for Medicare For All, organizing
volunteers, and helping build the kind of people-powered campaigns that
can actually beat billionaires, corporations, and their dark money. I have
to tell you — what I’ve seen has been nothing short of extraordinary. It
has filled me with the kind of hope and determination that will keep my
tank full and running all the way to November.

In Michigan, I rallied with Abdul El-Sayed — one of the most principled
leaders I’ve had the privilege of knowing, a man that made Medicare For
All central to his campaign — who stood up for working people while more
than $60 million in outside money was spent trying to defeat him.

$15 million from Big Pharma and health insurance interests who know
exactly what Medicare for All would mean for their profit margins. Over
$40 million from AIPAC, targeting his clear eyed and courageous position
on ending U.S. taxpayer funding for the genocide in Gaza.

He was outspent 10:1. But it didn’t matter,
Peter. He won anyway.

Because when you give the people something real to fight for — something
they can believe in, that will truly tap into the fire in their bellies
and the hope in their hearts — no amount of dark money can stop them.

In Minnesota, I joined Peggy Flannagan who faced a very similar onslaught
of dark money. $20 million. She was outspent 7:1. The ads were awful and
relentless. But guess what? She still won by 20 points.

That’s because Peggy did what too few leaders are willing to do: she told
the truth about what’s broken and offered a real vision for fixing it.
That is the kind of integrity and grit that makes the fighters of our
progressive movement a force to be reckoned with. It’s what makes me proud
to stand alongside them doing this work.

In Michigan’s 7th district, I stood up with William Lawrence who faced
over $4.5 million in outside spending aimed at defeating him. The other
side threw everything they had at him. Groups with ties to corporate
interests flooded the airwaves with attack ads in the final days. He was
outspent, outgunned, and still won — on a platform of Medicare for All,
housing affordability, and standing up to billionaires who think they can
buy our elections.

In Minnesota’s 2nd district, I supported Matt Little who was targeted by
the same dark money machine for the very same reasons. Several
AIPAC-affiliated groups poured over $3.5 million into the race to boost
his opponent who had openly refused to call the genocide in Gaza by it’s
name. In the final weeks, another $2.5 million poured into the race to
flood the airwaves and overwhelm a grassroots campaign that had been built
one door, one conversation, one Medicare For All town hall at a time. They
outspent him, and Matt won anyway.

In California, I door knocked alongside Aisha Wahab who won her June
primary by 25 points. Since then, outside groups have poured more than
$6.3 million into efforts to defeat her. They’ve run misleading attack ads
and disparaging mailers to tear down a candidate who has spent her entire
career fighting for her community.

Race after race, we are seeing the same truth play out: you can spend
millions trying to buy an election, but you cannot buy people’s
convictions. You cannot buy their courage. And you sure as hell cannot buy
a movement.

Here’s what every one of these candidates had in common: the more fiercely
they fought for working people, the harder dark money came after them.
There is a real, undeniable hunger for leaders who will fight
unapologetically for working families — and refuse to back down when it
matters most.

Not for the corporations and billionaires who have spent decades rigging
this system in their favor.

Not for the insurance companies and pharmaceutical giants who line their
pockets while working people pay the price for our for-profit health care
system.

Not for the dark money special interests who pump tens of millions of
dollars into Democratic primaries just to protect their own investments.

For working families. For the simple, but powerful truth that healthcare
is a human right. That immigrants deserve dignity and humanity. That we
can’t send billions overseas while people here at home can’t afford gas in
their tanks and food on their tables. That the people of this country
deserve leaders who answer to them, and only them.

That is what our progressive movement stands for. And the dark money
forces we’re up against know it. The insurance industry, the
pharmaceutical companies, the special interests that profit from our
healthcare system — they know exactly what's at stake, and they’re
spending accordingly.

That’s why my Medicare for All PAC has invested millions to help these
candidates fight back. We may not be able to match them dollar for dollar,
but our small dollar raised funding and people power are keeping us in the
fight. And our record speaks for itself. We are winning! We’ve seen
incredible momentum up and down the ballot, but there is so much more to
come, Peter.
This is bigger than any one PAC, any single race, or any election cycle.

This is a movement.

Our movement.

And it’s up to us to continue fighting for it.

Dark money lost in Michigan. It lost in Minnesota. It’s losing across the
country in race after race. I genuinely believe what we’re witnessing
right now is the beginning of something absolutely historic.

A progressive movement that is organized, battle-tested, and refuses to be
bought. A generation of leaders who are showing what it looks like when
you run grassroots campaigns rooted in community, conviction, honesty, and
our collective power.

But we are not done,
Peter. Not by a long shot.

We must continue pushing forward until working families truly have a seat
at the table and the opportunity to thrive, not just survive.

Thank you for your commitment. Thank you for being a part of this movement
with me. Thank you for believing that a better future is possible.

I am more grateful than I can say to be in this fight alongside all of you
— and more certain than ever that we are going to win.

In solidarity,

Pramila Jayapal

name: OnePA Team
subject: RE: Politicians should not get richer from information the public never sees
body:
Public office should not come with the power to move markets and trade stocks for personal profit. | |
---
Peter, ******There are not many political issues where nearly three quarters of the country agrees. But right now, 72% of Americans support banning members of Congress and their live-in families from trading individual stocks.** People understand the problem because it is obvious. Public officials have access that ordinary people do not. They know what legislation is moving. They hear information in government briefings. They can influence regulations, budgets, and public spending. Giving the same people the ability to make personal trades while wielding that power invites conflicts that should never exist. **Communities in northeastern Pennsylvania decided they were done waiting for Washington to solve the problem. Organizers in Lackawanna and Luzerne Counties submitted more than 40,000 signatures for ballot initiatives establishing local insider trading restrictions and greater financial transparency.** They are proving that ordinary people can force accountability onto the agenda when politicians will not. That organizing should not stop at the county line. State governments make decisions every day affecting health care companies, utilities, developers, technology companies, contractors, banks, insurers, and countless other businesses. **The people making those decisions should never be able to turn privileged government information into a personal payday.** [**Tell your state legislators to ban insider trading by public officials and strengthen financial transparency in state government.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uU1mwbYMW9amKE-asg_toAraRXdyqRMDpzio_X5zK-euNprZ_AzDZ7GRq1BvlLBy8z1HcGMtCt-FhDTx8p-xnak8g19fjoKBQfBouor1EBMJ94uU8ZVycrVqD0nu5KN7Jchbbf1GXpF68xNbMl-xqvnpLYCwEhdtaq4dcduXfQn-WQBy0rYD-QKQVEStuxRamDzfGU8dVehx1d2B6psc2LIqdCukwcY-NQ05dVcUwr-Q4pMz9cBGeZfq7Q8YHanzcnipl8d5DoSLAOxo4-gdq2D_NX6UAowgliCuIVFUwKZukpGI5Xo4cCAWCBsE5yu5yY3rhdEwyPhzXY24HS7NbiEIfD2wiSHIGnDpRO1s2L14nQqjftcElQ-qM6IHgiuVazeFfWeP8sWy9xRNaIknP1NZKSNUjSJs0vYNScq3KEbHAZYB9TA3uHyfpubliVTs/4ts/h5fEKoluSImjnbY6mu6sYQ/h0/h001.l9fyGu84aw-GDgm9tEBU54r1LSY-KWY1y6O9ODfBgVg) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uU1mwbYMW9amKE-asg_toAraRXdyqRMDpzio_X5zK-euNprZ_AzDZ7GRq1BvlLBy8z1HcGMtCt-FhDTx8p-xnak8g19fjoKBQfBouor1EBO-p6NP0C4TCmSB89gHvKLlbzn8OwomjlFt-XxoNvBLJ26wxMH-akHywPLG0w-OdSGIUI7w6BXMdzD9FK3H2AqreurzvAKWM55dzL1zofQG3HyfjevWRrnP5lSDJK3MGJw-ztmLA4cQ8tR_D9zUJhqyniFEj45BNrAcCw_wplV2z0JSlShtUAaBUCrqXKBMullERKexKpFmdaIpJK4sYxU_EwenyMovS6pPYm7Mls4Q1r3b5QBtPKm8yEoQzeyof2HJNuHRL-IWazlJzt5dvX4Upv0cK8SFiLiEF_oaKta3TBI2My8id9TyNlYEn3p03-z8N7M_Inif98PKkPud5ZPw/4ts/h5fEKoluSImjnbY6mu6sYQ/h1/h001.KvxdKefN69-hRgPd9zdr8YOl8XUJloHEyi7vv-ixK3U)
---
The principle could hardly be simpler. If you learned it through public office, you should not be able to profit from it. That means strong prohibitions on trades or prediction-market bets based on nonpublic information obtained through official duties, backed by disclosure rules and real consequences for violations.
**People should not have to become amateur stock trackers to figure out whether their elected officials are serving them.** They should not have to compare financial disclosures against votes on health care, energy, taxes, contracts, or development projects to determine whether somebody in office had a personal financial interest riding on the outcome.
Government belongs to the people. The authority entrusted to elected officials comes from our communities, and organizing together gives those communities the power to demand better. NEPA residents are putting that idea into practice right now.
**State legislators across the country have the opportunity to do the same. They can establish clear rules that protect public trust and make clear that holding office is a responsibility to the people, not an opportunity to use privileged access for personal gain.**
[**Tell your state legislators that public service must _mean_ public service and demand an insider trading ban now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uU1mwbYMW9amKE-asg_toAraRXdyqRMDpzio_X5zK-euNprZ_AzDZ7GRq1BvlLBy8z1HcGMtCt-FhDTx8p-xnak8g19fjoKBQfBouor1EBN6Cddg6sjkPEIDLo0QpKoyWZeuV4J4r1sVu6IrIsIBZqL7Na5ikGuNmRDApzWyE60SySXlUHoaCtCNJuLjeEe_EB2OotKf35zkI45hUzuZ5BqxM4yXokJHz1ouHL1YMbjtVxPHUHb6u9K4BdK-J4d_7JKIwpW1jBwNg9FPfs9Nh0GGAngRYvWo5LL8gyoMVpKqsMAU7PJyxy4x63XdxGQh7xuIzxgIcGmR8eHHzea1VlNFNG34RzZSQwZKTQWaE1NVM1C9P6UGGI6Fk-s7NOzINct0gy1QEH3CSsxIl2lkP9ATg_jJipE2N9QkMktNioWsQmQSOsOD7FXvWYJcdJ-8/4ts/h5fEKoluSImjnbY6mu6sYQ/h2/h001.IcC3GXcTabzkdEckwKhZ0wvzgxY5MuCaEH9ezl6XFrE)
Let’s make accountability the rule.
-OnePA

| [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6b7511fe294e4f23861361526d3293b1&_e=KQjg3SNRXxwonm0CKQcmpA6d93yQG3Flr8PAofPh3CvD3oAfJf_xtTJdKTUDTTsQlvCtA8yk7YCbfkqzhKhFjssoKECCnumstdrQoGw4amZmx58wa_O1VTqXgfWEBLZC-PPmLA3BJ_ZKMD6jcmtkHEcnO4i8CQpcOrACNjGUJgkRey_lPWua_ovjK4NlEmy49yDbCU6PqFKXBX1A_zd7OCtZLZdc5EO1c_8oWL-J0_0BRnq_HDRqkeKOhQ8W4LjFh1UOCHPKQgkBJq-mZVj4tdUA3KoQqDCrlzqSzFr9_BUmBrSr4g8pGj7J6ELDMmLRyes2O13I0nbdja_fHPiSyltNZNrKcGRNCGpONKHMnKlNaF04KeiQYDWqiULH-LWMZicN4i80dRLiWcoOx5nsWRceSTXwJaexkqCO8xIpPwK1MtDGvZgRIZAutPI2mMwu20rRfufSEUUkqKrE5fG98xy-J_vBn3xMQ02KqL5iX9lkRSjpZtyRMeDA_HgN1P5yM9c_oVSpzKGTTqIHVgkfD9EvFKeSBwDtfCz-ZN5mqJowbYe8Nbiguq-CKgCrkycekFokYYGYpAzLlPwhvCVKOrMWk9ODBIPTNlW0RxKzPZ1xiVPrwjyYG1n-i_33mDGsGsTyh5fCinSQZe66FarVaCmHwTh4mGx_jYLgVGfCMWI%3D)Dear Friend,

When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding.

Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different.

So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift.

That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me.

We're producing _Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie_ --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust.

As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today.

I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us.

When you take the pledge, you'll receive **exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming,** along with updates as the project moves forward and opportunities to help bring stories like this to life.

The pledge says:_I believe it is crucial to support projects like this to help raise a generation of children who understand and value the truth about our country --so that truth is not lost to the next generation._If that reflects what you believe, I hope you'll take a moment to sign the pledge and enjoy these exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming.

**Add your name to the pledge here:[**https://offers.americancornerstone.org/star-spangled-adventures-movie**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6b7511fe294e4f23861361526d3293b1&_e=KQjg3SNRXxwonm0CKQcmpA6d93yQG3Flr8PAofPh3CvD3oAfJf_xtTJdKTUDTTsQlvCtA8yk7YCbfkqzhKhFjssoKECCnumstdrQoGw4amZmx58wa_O1VTqXgfWEBLZC-PPmLA3BJ_ZKMD6jcmtkHEcnO4i8CQpcOrACNjGUJgkRey_lPWua_ovjK4NlEmy49yDbCU6PqFKXBX1A_zd7OCtZLZdc5EO1c_8oWL-J0_0Or0g15sjja07yBZ07SLuecJatfD4SAEnAjFHEwZeLFONNceOMGahRlfGbIPX7kDeRVKz0pJ783z-4BfxLvrt3WMT3Gek70sYSjR3fk3meQ3oTO_8Dr4bhDqFcm9-uNKA1Yi9HZ6XAhoj3mKbsmdlvtbapl741sx6gS1GUyDpl76u2eEuQcFdOb_39_DIGRDSet94jdrQYHYiP8GtwYe9R3Nbi7uAv6ON1lZXYfvrP0HWm6mKmvMRw6JCFk341D3mdyzIl0wbOr78uSundYRGfDX8rN6EHWLMuNiHou3zQAoZYVRmXcbMSJvigUi735RCrTQETW__FoAydVhutDlsB4LmsII2oPSvN303yj_-T5AdYsFGBZnTIuLqnC95bhbEJ1gbUd4CTEnZb0Iba6vXL9sQ3coKdQNpadorrlG30T20j9qb4F7yGh1AC1b8vHcU%3D)**

Thank you for caring about the stories shaping our children--and the future they will inherit.

With gratitude,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

clean_body: | | | | | Friend, When many of us were growing up, the stories we watched and read reinforced things like character, responsibility, and a basic understanding of where our country came from. Those stories weren't perfect--but they helped give us a sense of grounding. Today, the media children are absorbing looks very different. So much of what kids watch now either ignores America's history altogether or presents it in confusing and misleading ways. Children are forming their understanding of the world earlier than ever, and without a clear foundation, it's no wonder so many young adults today feel disconnected, uncertain, and adrift. That's one of the reasons this project matters so much to me. We're producing Star Spangled Adventures: The Movie --a new film created specifically for children to help them understand America's story through engaging, clear, and inspiring storytelling. It's designed to be something families can watch together and trust. As our nation approaches its 250th anniversary this year, I believe we have a responsibility to be intentional about the stories we pass on. What the next generation believes about our country, and about themselves, will be shaped by what they're taught today. I'd like to invite you to take a simple pledge to stand with us. When you take the pledge, you'll receive exclusive behind-the-scenes sneak peeks of filming, along with updates as the project moves forward and opportunities to help bring stories like this to life. | | | I need to tell you about a search term that should make your blood run cold. **_"Had an abortion, search for female."_** That's what a Texas sheriff's office typed into a nationwide surveillance tool to track down a woman who exercised her constitutional right to reproductive care. The search pulled data from more than **6,800 networks and 83,000 cameras** — including cameras right here in Illinois, in a state where abortion is legal. Here's how it works: A company called **Flock Group** sells automatic license plate readers to police departments across the country, marketed as a public safety tool. In reality, it's become a surveillance dragnet — one that lets any local law enforcement agency, anywhere, search a nationwide network of cameras for any reason they type into a box. And it's not just reproductive care. In Richmond, Virginia — a city with an explicit policy against helping federal immigration enforcement — an ATF analyst used Flock's network to run immigration queries anyway. Richmond had to block federal access entirely just to protect its own residents from a company they never agreed to let ICE use. Months ago, I launched a formal investigation into Flock Group alongside Oversight Committee Ranking Member Robert Garcia. We are demanding a full accounting of every search involving "abortion," "ICE," or "CBP." We are demanding Flock's contracts and communications with ICE. We are demanding to know what, if anything, they've done to stop this abuse. I've spent my career fighting for privacy, civil liberties, and reproductive freedom, and I am not going to let a private company build a nationwide tracking network and call it a public service. clean_body: | | | | = | | | I need to tell you about a search term that should make your blood run cold. "Had an abortion, search for female." That's what a Texas sheriff's office typed into a nationwide surveillance tool to track down a woman who exercised her constitutional right to reproductive care. The search pulled data from more than 6,800 networks and 83,000 cameras — including cameras right here in Illinois, in a state where abortion is legal. Here's how it works: A company called Flock Group sells automatic license plate readers to police departments across the country, marketed as a public safety tool. In reality, it's become a surveillance dragnet — one that lets any local law enforcement agency, anywhere, search a nationwide network of cameras for any reason they type into a box. And it's not just reproductive care. In Richmond, Virginia — a city with an explicit policy against helping federal immigration enforcement — an ATF analyst used Flock's network to run immigration queries anyway. Richmond had to block federal access entirely just to protect its own residents from a company they never agreed to let ICE use. Months ago, I launched a formal investigation into Flock Group alongside Oversight Committee Ranking Member Robert Garcia. We are demanding a full accounting of every search involving "abortion," "ICE," or "CBP." We are demanding Flock's contracts and communications with ICE. We are demanding to know what, if anything, they've done to stop this abuse. I've spent my career fighting for privacy, civil liberties, and reproductive freedom, and I am not going to let a private company build a nationwide tracking network and call it a public service. = | | | If you have saved your information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process instantly. | | | ****= | **= | | **= | **= | | **= | **= Your license plate should not be a weapon used against you. — Raja Krishnamoorthi Founder | Equal Opportunity Now | = Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC) Equal Opportunity Now P.O. body:
#
Hey there, Peter.
As summer comes to a close, one of my favorite times of the year is back: the Minnesota State Fair!
This 12-day affair is a proud tradition of our state going all the way back to 1859. Of course, I was there on Day 1 to get my fair share of good eats and great conversation with my fellow Minnesotans.
If you’ve been, then you know how hard it is to choose what to order because there are SO many options. This year — _so far_ — I grabbed a SPAM (one of Minnesota’s greatest achievements) breakfast sandwich and the new apple donut ham grinder (it’s good, people).
I even had the chance to serve the best corn in the world! 🌽
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260905-1.ey1cED&amount=5&refcode=em20260905-1056&t=2&akid=1056%2E34582%2E8SSMiE)
Events like this bring people from all walks of life together in community: families, farmers, chefs, service workers, veterans, educators, car collectors, musicians, artists, and more.
The Great Minnesota Get Together is just one of many things that make our small towns and rural communities so special.
**Working families in places like this all over the country deserve representation in Washington that looks out for them and preserves these wonderful traditions.**
The 2026 midterm elections are coming up fast, and with Small Town PAC, I’ve endorsed three impressive Democratic candidates with working-class backgrounds running to flip three U.S. House seats from red to blue.
[**The more we raise from grassroots supporters like you, the more we can give to support their campaigns and get them over the finish line this November. So Peter, can you pitch in $5 or more today?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260905-1.ey1cED&amount=5&refcode=em20260905-1056&t=3&akid=1056%2E34582%2E8SSMiE)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260905-1.ey1cED&amount=5&refcode=20260905-1056&t=22&akid=1056%2E34582%2E8SSMiE)**
Thanks for all you do to fuel our work, and if you’re in the St. Paul area this long weekend, I hope you’ll come by the MN State Fair!
With gratitude,
Tim

Ten months ago I was in Iraq.
Ten months ago this campaign did not exist.
_**Here is part of what I told that room:**_
_"I spent over a decade in the Army, as an infantry officer in the 101st Airborne Division and as an intelligence officer in the 82nd Airborne Division. I worked every single day to ensure that this country was safe from those who would do it harm."_
_**And then the part that actually matters:**_
_"In the race for Michigan's 10th Congressional District, the choice could not be more clear between my opponent Christina Hines and myself."_
Let me show you exactly what I mean by that.
I support the tax cuts on overtime pay. I support the tax cuts on tips. I support the tax cuts for seniors on Social Security. Christina Hines opposes them, and she has said she would repeal them. I support ending taxpayer funding for gender transition surgeries. She does not.
I have served as a reserve sheriff's deputy in Oakland County for over a decade. I believe criminals should be held accountable. That is not a campaign line, it is common sense, and we are going to bring it back.
I bring up records because actions speak louder than words. I spent my career defending this country from the people who want to hurt it. Others spent theirs putting them back on the street.
That is a clear contrast. But here is the part I care about most, and it is the reason I got in this race at all.
I do not just want to give people something to vote against. I want to give people something to vote **FOR.** Policies that actually help the families in this district. And I want to give people hope.
This is truly the greatest country in the world. I love this country. I know you do too, or you would not have read this far. We just need to unite as Americans once again, and it is time to put our people first, our country first, and this district first.
I am honored to be your nominee. I believe our best days are ahead of us.
_But none of that message reaches a single voter on its own. Christina Hines has EMILY's List. She has the DCCC. She has the national money that follows a seat the other side has decided it needs._
I have _you_. That is the entire operation.
If you can chip in today, it goes straight into reaching the voters in Macomb and Oakland who have not heard my name yet.

And then the part that actually matters: "In the race for Michigan's 10th Congressional District, the choice could not be more clear between my opponent Christina Hines and myself." Let me show you exactly what I mean by that. I support the tax cuts on overtime pay. I support the tax cuts on tips. I support the tax cuts for seniors on Social Security. Christina Hines opposes them, and she has said she would repeal them. I support ending taxpayer funding for gender transition surgeries. She does not. I have served as a reserve sheriff's deputy in Oakland County for over a decade. I believe criminals should be held accountable. That is not a campaign line, it is common sense, and we are going to bring it back. I bring up records because actions speak louder than words. I spent my career defending this country from the people who want to hurt it. Others spent theirs putting them back on the street. That is a clear contrast. But here is the part I care about most, and it is the reason I got in this race at all. I do not just want to give people something to vote against. I want to give people something to vote FOR. Policies that actually help the families in this district. And I want to give people hope. This is truly the greatest country in the world. I love this country. I know you do too, or you would not have read this far. We just need to unite as Americans once again, and it is time to put our people first, our country first, and this district first. I am honored to be your nominee. I believe our best days are ahead of us. But none of that message reaches a single voter on its own. Christina Hines has EMILY's List. She has the DCCC. She has the national money that follows a seat the other side has decided it needs. I have you. That is the entire operation. If you can chip in today, it goes straight into reaching the voters in Macomb and Oakland who have not heard my name yet. | | Thank you for standing with me. subject: 1.2 million registered Texas voters have been placed on the voter “suspense” list.
body:
Greg Abbott is counting on us to sit this election out.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Recent news has created massive confusion across Texas because 1.2 million registered Texas voters have been placed on the voter “suspense” list.
When voters see headlines like this, many people assume that their registration has been cancelled or that they can no longer cast a ballot. This confusion is extremely dangerous, and it plays in Greg Abbott’s favor.
**I want to be clear about what this news means. Being on the voter suspense list does not mean your voter registration has been purged. It simply means that local officials need an updated address before October 5th – the voter registration deadline here in Texas.**
Abbott and Republicans know that confusion can discourage people from the polls. And they do these deliberate tactics so that people are discouraged from showing up, because they know that the stakes of this race couldn’t be higher.
**And Abbott also knows that when Texans turn out, his time in office is up. That’s why we can’t allow a single eligible voter to be sidelined by confusion or bureaucratic red tape.**
Our campaign is organizing on the ground every single day between now and November to clear up the confusion, reach voters directly, and make sure our community is ready to make their voices heard at the ballot box.
**[Will you chip in $5 right now so we have the resources to organize from now until November and make sure every Texan is ready to vote Greg Abbott out?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260905_2_voterrolls.ZwKc3-&refcode=em20260905-2039&amount=5&t=1&akid=2039%2E299639%2EwOsrYD)**

clean_body: Greg Abbott is counting on us to sit this election out. Peter, Recent news has created massive confusion across Texas because 1.2 million registered Texas voters have been placed on the voter “suspense” list. When voters see headlines like this, many people assume that their registration has been cancelled or that they can no longer cast a ballot. This confusion is extremely dangerous, and it plays in Greg Abbott’s favor. I want to be clear about what this news means. Being on the voter suspense list does not mean your voter registration has been purged. It simply means that local officials need an updated address before October 5th – the voter registration deadline here in Texas. Abbott and Republicans know that confusion can discourage people from the polls. And they do these deliberate tactics so that people are discouraged from showing up, because they know that the stakes of this race couldn’t be higher. And Abbott also knows that when Texans turn out, his time in office is up. That’s why we can’t allow a single eligible voter to be sidelined by confusion or bureaucratic red tape. Our campaign is organizing on the ground every single day between now and November to clear up the confusion, reach voters directly, and make sure our community is ready to make their voices heard at the ballot box. Hi team,
A constituent told Dan Meuser that she's concerned about rising health care costs as she gets older and retires.
His response to that was, **" some serious mistakes were made."**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1bbcc1a-02a0-44aa-b487-605722cc4e32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Dan conveniently forgot to mention that this is exactly what he voted for. He voted to cut $1 trillion from Medicaid and end the ACA subsidies.
Kicking 30,000 of your constituents off their health care and putting rural hospitals on the brink of closing is not something you just say "oops" to.
**And it was definitely not a "mistake." The money Dan voted to cut from health care went directly into the pockets of his billionaire donors.**
This is what happens when a representative is bought by corporate PACs and big-money interests. That's who they fight for.
I'm in this for you, so I'm funded by you. I'm running to lower health care costs, reverse Dan's cuts, and hold insurance companies and their executives accountable.
**[If you 're with me, chip in to my campaign today to help put someone who's actually on our side in Congress.](https://substack.com/redirect/f1bbcc1a-02a0-44aa-b487-605722cc4e32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Rachel Wallace

Kicking 30,000 of your constituents off their health care and putting rural hospitals on the brink of closing is not something you just say "oops" to. And it was definitely not a "mistake." # [MESSAGE FROM PRESIDENT TRUMP:](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Standing up for what you believe in is never easy.

Along the way, there will be challenges. You will stumble and fall, struggle, and face opposition to your progress.

The MAGA movement is no different.

Every single day, new battles arise.

**From the moment I wake up at****5 AM****, the Radical Left does everything in their power to destroy me.**

Ever since I came down the golden escalator in Trump Tower and declared my nomination for President of the United States in 2015, **__I’ve been their #1 target.__**

After all, I’m a political outsider. Untouched by the D.C swamp. Driven by one mission only: to restore this country for the people who built it.

**All I’ve ever hoped and dreamed of was to MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN.**

Yet still, the Radical Left tried everything.

[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
They came for my family and friends.

They tried to smear my reputation, they’ve created fake, scandalous stories about my past, and they even tried to destroy my future.

They used paid-for, CORRUPT judges in an attempt to throw me into prison.

**But everything they tried failed.**

**_[That’s because I made a promise to you that I will always follow. I will never waver, never falter, and never surrender in my mission to Save America.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_** **_[]()_**
From that 5 AM wake-up, I’m fighting a war every single day on behalf of every American man, woman, and child.

**For YOU and your family.**

No matter how challenging things get, I will never ask for sympathy or pity. I chose this path and it’s been the greatest honor of my life.
**Occasionally, I must ask my supporters to stand with me but I only do so when it matters most. These times are make or break moments.**

_Right now, in this critical hour, that moment is here._
**This is the moment that will define us.**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
For years, you have watched me absorb every blow without flinching. You have refused to walk away when others did.

_**[Now put your name on the line. This is the moment that will define our movement.>>](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)**_
**_[If you are still standing with me and the MAGA Movement in our most desperate hour, I, President Donald J. Trump am humbly asking you to go on the record below:](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

I got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like Ben would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children. Now, with extremists like Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. attacking key rights and protections for the disability community, that mission has become more important than ever. That’s why I’ve taken on RFK Jr. for his radical conspiracy theories, his anti-vaccine platform, and his blatant attacks on Americans who live with disabilities. And I’ve stood up to Trump’s efforts to slash Medicaid and government services that the disability community relies on. Proposition 212 — the Protect Education Act — would have asked Arizona voters to institute sweeping regulations on the state's billion-dollar school voucher program. Supporters turned in nearly _420,000 signatures_. Arizonans showed up in massive numbers to put this on the ballot. **And then the voucher lobby went to court to kill it.** The lengths that the voucher lobby went to invalidate signatures with scorched-earth legal objections shows just how terrified they are of Arizona voters actually having a say in how our tax dollars are spent. They knew Arizona voters would prioritize funding a robust public education system over a $1 billion ESA voucher program siphoning tax dollars to unregulated private schools. They were right to be terrified. So they made sure voters never got the chance. This year will be the first even-numbered year since 2014 with no citizen-initiated measures on the statewide ballot because Republicans have spent years making it harder for voters to bypass their legislature and make their voices heard directly. Arizona Democrats are furious. And we're fighting back. Arizona Senate Democrats made clear: this ruling "cannot stop the fight for accountability." We are supporting candidates up and down the ballot — including **Terry Leyba Ruiz for Superintendent of Public Instruction** and Democrats running for state legislature — who will fight for public schools, hold the voucher program accountable, and make sure Arizona's tax dollars go to Arizona's kids. The voucher lobby killed Prop. 212 in court. We're going to beat them at the ballot box. name: Roy Cooper
subject: Lies, money and yet more lies
body:
I simply cannot fight back and win without your help.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1299&source=&t=1&akid=3204%2E124072%2EmQllFE) | | | |

Our Senate race is heating up, Peter.

Over the past couple months, we’ve received an outpouring of grassroots support from people who are fed up with what’s happening in our country and ready for change.
Those folks know we can’t let my opponent, Washington DC insider Michael Whatley, and his MAGA allies buy this seat.
Their $5 and $10 donations are critically important: Experts say that Democrats have no chance at taking back the Senate without winning in North Carolina.
**But Republicans are seeing our momentum, and they’re panicking.** President Trump and JD Vance are personally attacking me with lies and spreading misinformation – and the Senate GOP’s top super PAC is currently spending more in North Carolina than almost any other battleground state _in the country._
**Peter, the GOP’s attacks are working: A recent poll shows me statistically tied with my MAGA opponent.**
[**I’m confident in the grassroots movement we’re building, but I simply cannot fight back and win without your help. Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 or more today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1299&amount=5&t=8&akid=3204%2E124072%2EmQllFE)

Last year, at least 88 of the biggest corporations in America paid zero dollars in federal corporate income taxes last year — even while posting healthy pretax profits here in the U.S. _**That didn’t happen by accident.**_ It’s the predictable result when politicians cut taxes for big companies and then let the people who profit from those cuts write the rules. Meanwhile, the same interests pushing for tax giveaways are also the ones pouring money into political campaigns and lobbying for loopholes that benefit them. My GOP opponent, Rob Bresnahan, accepts corporate donations from companies like these and continues to sell out NEPA anytime he can pad his portfolio. This is how corporate money in politics works: it buys influence, it shapes policy, and it shields profits from public accountability. You can see the consequences clearly — promises about protecting healthcare or restoring fairness rings hollow when the policies coming out of DC tilt toward special interests instead of families. I’m running for office to change that. I’ll fight to restore transparency, ban corporate PAC donations, and restore public trust by making decisions that are best for our families, not corporations.
