At the GOP Senate debate, John Sununu told a roomful of Republicans he’s
running to send me back to “bussing tables” at my family’s “chicken
restaurant.” He meant it as an insult.

As if the people who work in restaurants — cooking your food, clearing
your plates, keeping family businesses alive — have something to be
embarrassed about.

My great-grandfather came to New Hampshire from Greece over a century ago
and opened a candy shop in Manchester. My family built it into a
restaurant that’s been serving our community ever since.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260905_3.VPlbqb&refcode=em20260905-3&t=1003&akid=8721%2E582294%2EXaJltH ]Puritan Backroom sign

John Sununu was born into a political dynasty. His father was governor and
White House Chief of Staff. His brother was governor. John went to
Washington and then spent the next 17 years cashing in with Big Oil, Big
Pharma, and Wall Street.

Oh, and his family business invested in a literal gold mine in Azerbaijan
that sells minerals to China. He’s never had to work hard a day in his
life — and his comments at that debate prove exactly what he thinks of
people who do.

The people who bus tables, flip burgers, and run small businesses in New
Hampshire don’t need a senator who looks down on them. They need one who
comes from them.

clean_body: [ ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ ]Chris Pappas for Senate At the GOP Senate debate, John Sununu told a roomful of Republicans he’s running to send me back to “bussing tables” at my family’s “chicken restaurant.” He meant it as an insult. As if the people who work in restaurants — cooking your food, clearing your plates, keeping family businesses alive — have something to be embarrassed about. My great-grandfather came to New Hampshire from Greece over a century ago and opened a candy shop in Manchester. My family built it into a restaurant that’s been serving our community ever since. [ ]Puritan Backroom sign John Sununu was born into a political dynasty. His father was governor and White House Chief of Staff. His brother was governor. John went to Washington and then spent the next 17 years cashing in with Big Oil, Big Pharma, and Wall Street. Oh, and his family business invested in a literal gold mine in Azerbaijan that sells minerals to China. He’s never had to work hard a day in his life — and his comments at that debate prove exactly what he thinks of people who do. The people who bus tables, flip burgers, and run small businesses in New Hampshire don’t need a senator who looks down on them. They need one who comes from them. [ ]Donate $5 » John Sununu doesn’t know the real New Hampshire. I do. That’s why I’m running for Senate. — Chris Pappas [ ]Chris Pappas You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

body:

---
| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

President Donald Trump's deportation efforts are now well-known and migrants who are waiting in other parts of the world are worried about the new tactics Trump's second administration has implemented.
The Trump administration is capitalizing on sending illegal immigrants to countries who are not their home country in the event the individual has an order to not be returned there. This typically stems from either the home nation not accepting deportations or the person has claims of persecution in their country.
Starting during his first term, the United States has expanded its third-country agreements beyond Latin America. We now have these types of agreements with eight countries in Africa: Sierra Leone, Cameroon, Liberia, the Central African Republic, Burundi, Equatorial Guinea, Eswatini, Rwanda, and Eswatini.

* * *
The news of deportees being sent to places they have never been to, don't speak the language, or never even heard of is making many question their plans to illegally enter the United States.
I confirmed these concerns during a recent trip to Tijuana, Mexico, where migrants and Mexicans who work with them said not only are people illegally crossing in fewer numbers but they have largely stopped coming to the border city altogether.
## Watch:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/29b1ab5d-7452-476b-a500-7b16574eaaf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/29b1ab5d-7452-476b-a500-7b16574eaaf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It is not just the effects of seeing deportations to Africa that have given migrants a pause, but it is also seeing Trump's attempts to end birthright citizenship and daily viral videos of ICE and Border Patrol arresting everyone they can.
"For migrants from Mexico and other countries who want to cross into the United States, the situation becomes more difficult every day, and the risks become much greater...At a certain point, that has caused people to stop coming to the border," said Jose Maria Garcia Lara, the coordinator for the Tijuana Migrant Alliance.
"Many people definitely returned to their cities of origin. Others returned to their countries of origin," said Diana Ortiz Villacorta Ramirez, the municipal director for Migrant Services in Tijuana. For the migrants who have remained by the border, "we have seen the successful integration of many people, repatriated Mexicans as well as foreigners, of course."
The number of deportees sent into Tijuana has likewise dropped, not because deportations are fewer, but because DHS is increasingly flying Mexicans further south. In some cases, Mexicans have been deported to other Latin American countries.
"Last year, we were receiving 100 or 200 people a day. Right now, we receive 10, 15 or 20 people," Villacorta Ramirez explained.
Trump's efforts to carry out mass deportations has been a constant debate among his supporters, with some saying he is not following through. In Mexico, it is clear the arrests and policy changes have made a substantial impact in stemming the flow.
This is why the outcome of the midterms are important. Since it appears that Democrats can take control of Congress, migrants are starting to slowly come back to other parts of the border. It is worth mentioning illegal border crossings are still happening, though significantly lower than during the Biden era. They are hoping a Democrat-controlled Congress can reign in Trump's immigration policies.

| | _With just three days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 3, I am highlighting the need to protect the right to vote and ensure that every vote is counted._
* * *
Dear David, I am an election commissioner, and I take the job very seriously. **Especially in 2026.** [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TtuGljK5J6L-UnqxiPX5cA~~/AAUS1hA~/fLSkwS4Qo5CaiUSLAtLVwMqygbK0DI0tWJpEDjcFlZd7eX3t6W6ZWTsFm2xxF5FUzNDIZyQWnXZqiPWuIBGb0ngtTWLq8ETDTuAwSeWPzidTVLlvpgnunEUNcfgsAWh6XxyipcBsHPD50WUDX_j2IJW8SjofJwO0-b7NtmlL9J9OWVorWhN60zKp7g0jNK2Q11fBGYAxNQ_7_9w5z6YNqYRTE3RlRdq8tYnqJ4HNJcQlfVc_eOnl_XFPDewZDl-uLaUaqR_lua_mSpKK5rrzMw~~) Being an election commissioner means that I wake up bright and early on election days. I get to the polls around 6:30 a.m. to make sure the booths are set up, the ballots are prepped, and everyone has their pens. I stay there all day and all night and into the wee hours of the following morning with one goal in mind: **make sure every vote is counted.** **[If you believe that we need more leaders in Congress who will fight to protect the right to vote, I’d be honored to have your support today.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TtuGljK5J6L-UnqxiPX5cA~~/AAUS1hA~/fLSkwS4Qo5CaiUSLAtLVwMqygbK0DI0tWJpEDjcFlZd7eX3t6W6ZWTsFm2xxF5FUzNDIZyQWnXZqiPWuIBGb0ngtTWLq8ETDTuAwSeWPzidTVLlvpgnunEUNcfgsAWh6XxyipcBsHPD50WUDX_j2IJW8SjofJwO0-b7NtmlL9J9OWVorWhN60zKp7g0jNK2Q11fBGYAxNQ_7_9w5z6YNqYRTE3RlRdq8tYnqJ4HNJcQlfVc_eOnl_XFPDewZDl-uLaUaqR_lua_mSpKK5rrzMw~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TtuGljK5J6L-UnqxiPX5cA~~/AAUS1hA~/fLSkwS4Qo5CaiUSLAtLVwMqygbK0DI0tWJpEDjcFlZd7eX3t6W6ZWTsFm2xxF5FUzNDIZyQWnXZqiPWuIBGb0ngtTWLq8ETDTuAwSeWPzidTVLlvpgnunEUNcfgsAWh6XxyipcBsHPD50WUDX_j2IJW8SjofJwO0-b7NtmlL9J9OWVorWhN60zKp7g0jNK2Q11fBGYAxNQ_7_9w5z6YNqYRTE3RlRdq8tYnqJ4HNJcQlfVc_eOnl_XFPDewZDl-uLaUaqR_lua_mSpKK5rrzMw~~)

**In America, politicians should not get to pick their voters.** Sounds simple enough, right? That is so painfully obvious that most pollsters don’t even bother to ask the question, and everyone I meet agrees.
But Republicans in Washington, and their hand-picked supermajority on the Supreme Court, have come to the maddening conclusion that corporations are people and serving the interests of the rich and powerful requires them to shred the fabric of what makes our country great: democracy, civic participation, the voice of the people.
Earlier this year, the 6-3 conservative majority on the Supreme Court issued a devastating blow to the Voting Rights Act by invalidating Louisiana’s congressional map that included two majority-Black districts. This gives state legislatures all across the country the green light to design congressional districts that guarantee seats for the majority party and deny representation to millions of people.
**The Supreme Court majority has taken power away from people and put it in the hands of politicians who will pursue power at any price and sell the tools of our government to the highest bidder.**
The truth is that the Voting Rights Act has been under attack for years, and as each section has been undermined and eviscerated, there have been fewer and fewer protections for minority voters across the country and fewer avenues for advocates for open democracy to challenge discriminatory and anti-democratic actions on the part of Republicans looking to rig the system for the wealthy and well-connected.
**In Congress, I will fight for a Voting Rights Act for the 21st Century:** legislation that bans partisan gerrymandering, establishes independent redistricting commissions, defends against discriminatory barriers to voting, and fights for meaningful and lasting campaign finance reform.
**[It doesn’t matter how much money you have, how many political insiders you have in your contact list, or whether you and I agree on every issue (or any issue). We have built this campaign around a simple premise: every vote counts. Can you help me take this work to Congress by pitching in today to ensure everyone has a voice in our future?](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/TtuGljK5J6L-UnqxiPX5cA~~/AAUS1hA~/fLSkwS4Qo5CaiUSLAtLVwMqygbK0DI0tWJpEDjcFlZd7eX3t6W6ZWTsFm2xxF5FUzNDIZyQWnXZqiPWuIBGb0ngtTWLq8ETDTuAwSeWPzidTVLlvpgnunEUNcfgsAWh6XxyipcBsHPD50WUDX_j2IJW8SjofJwO0-b7NtmlL9J9OWVorWhN60zKp7g0jNK2Q11fBGYAxNQ_7_9w5z6YNqYRTE3RlRdq8tYnqJ4HNJcQlfVc_eOnl_XFPDewZDl-uLaUaqR_lua_mSpKK5rrzMw~~)**

**“..._closer-than-expected_ margin in New Mexico’s race for governor”** **_Thank you._ Friend, because of you, we just pulled ahead in the polls.** All the support folks like you have given this campaign has helped us travel across this beautiful state, talk with New Mexicans, and make our case for a better future. _**But now we have to protect this lead.**_
I’m fighting to lower costs, put money back in New Mexicans’ pockets, strengthen our schools, protect our public lands, build safer communities, and stop anyone who would bring an extremist agenda to our state.
My opponent wants to bring Trump’s extreme agenda to New Mexico. He is ready to cut Medicaid, SNAP, and universal childcare — programs New Mexicans depend on to get ahead. **Republicans are coming for this seat. They’ve named our race a top pickup opportunity, and they’re willing to spend millions to flip it.** _And now, even the Albuquerque Journal is calling our margin “closer-than-expected.”_
**That’s why, with just weeks until Election Day, we have to keep fighting.** We’ve set a $100,000 goal that we need to hit before our reporting deadline on Monday at midnight. **_[Please chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me win this November so I can keep fighting for New Mexicans and deliver for working families.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16411?refcode=jtk1344-fr-nd&amount=5&t=4&akid=12194%2E400544%2EVPoU_2)_**

I'm a farmer. My overalls have dirt on them because I put it there, working my own land. My hands are rough. And I've never once been scared of hard work — I was raised to believe that if you want something to grow, you show up and you put the work in, every single day, rain or shine, no excuses. Mike Johnson has never worked a day like that in his life. He's spent his career in courtrooms and committee rooms, cutting deals for people who've never set foot on a farm in this district, let alone broken a sweat on one. And now, as Speaker of the House, he's used that power to gut Medicaid and turn a blind eye while a private company tortures our neighbors at Winn Correction Center. I'm a 6th-generation Louisianian. This is my home. And I grew up believing that the people who work the hardest and ask for the least are exactly the people who deserve to be fought for. That's not a talking point to me — that's just how I was raised. Mike Johnson wouldn't know honest, hard work if it walked up and shook his hand. I'm running because this district — our farms, our families, our neighbors — deserves a fighter who isn't afraid to get dirty for them. Not someone who answers to Washington donors and corporate PACs. Someone who answers to you. I know Mike Johnson and the powerful interests behind him are going to spend whatever it takes to keep this seat. They always do. But there are things money can't buy: the sweat you put into your own land, the loyalty you have to your neighbors, and the truth about who's actually willing to work for you. = = Thank you for standing with me. _**Cliff 's Note:**_
##### You have already read a Gloria Steinem obituary. Probably three. Every one of them was free and every one of them told you the same true things--Ms. magazine, the Playboy Club, fifty years on the road, the glasses, the hair.
##### This is not that. Below the line, I am going to walk you through something almost nobody is writing today, which is the actual procedural state of the Equal Rights Amendment: why thirty-eight states have ratified it and it still is not law, what a 1921 Supreme Court decision has to do with it, what Trump's Justice Department did in 2020 and what Biden's did in 2022 to partially undo it, and the specific sequence of moves that would put it in the Constitution starting the week a new Congress is sworn in.
##### That took real reporting time to assemble and it is the part I cannot give away, because the giving-away part is funded by the people who pay. There is no advertiser here, no network, no billionaire. There is me, a research folder, and you.
##### If you want to mourn her, the free half of this is for you and I mean every word of it.
##### [If you want to finish her job, come inside](https://substack.com/redirect/8f8e3d59-95f5-4428-9d92-807438ccf6e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

_**-- Cliff**_
* * *
_**by Cliff Schecter**_
In 2026, the late Gloria Steinem was interviewed as part of a _New York Times_ piece on what it was like to turn 80. She'd passed the barrier a decade earlier. But for some reason, because President Donald Trump was reaching 80 years of infesting our country with his unique combination of the seven deadly sins, Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, and piss cotton candy hair (thank you Penn Jillette!), the paper of broken record asked some famous folks their thoughts on the subject.
Steinem replied that the worst part passing the 80 year threshold was "losing people you love." But when they inquired if she had advice for Trump, specifically, she quickly remarked: "Resign." And that, in a nutshell, was Gloria Steinem.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8f8e3d59-95f5-4428-9d92-807438ccf6e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I grew up in a feminist household staunchly in favor of equal rights, including abortion rights, so women could participate equally in society. I heard this refrain from my mom, a lifelong liberal Democrat, from an early age. My late father, a Rockefeller Republican who subscribed to most of her politics--and by the time he passed in 2013, a decade record as a registered independent who voted Democratic--would nod along in agreement.
_Specifically, I 'd often hear about the necessity of passing the Equal Rights Amendment._
I thought about this, as I was saddened this past Wednesday upon hearing this giant of our politics and culture, Steinem, had passed away at age 92. I was somewhat consoled that she'd lived such a full life. Score one for this refutation of fellow New Yorker Billy Joel's take that "Only The Good Die Young." I was also comforted that Steinem had left such a lasting legacy. Truly a life we'd all be lucky to enjoy a fraction of during our time on Earth.
What she did honored us. So now it's our turn to honor her by finishing her job.
I am speaking of passing the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) as soon as humanly possible. And it's not as far away as you think.

My dad needs your help.

| | | | Peter, It's hard to watch someone you love get viciously attacked every hour on TV. My dad was the one who led me to Christ. He was the kind of dad who made you feel seen and loved. He showed up to my games and school events - present in the moments that mattered and in the quiet, ordinary ones too. The Left wants you to believe he's Public Enemy #1. But to me, he's simply **_" Dad."_**

Friend,[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) I’m reaching out to you not just as the Speaker, but simply as Mike. I’m sitting at my desk, and the weight of the road ahead is heavy. I’ve spent the last few hours looking at the map of our country, seeing just how thin the line is between protecting our values and losing them forever. I’ve written down exactly what I’m feeling—and why I believe you are essential to holding this movement together. I haven't shared this with the media. **[This is for you.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** [**_Please, will you read my personal letter?_**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Peter, I'm wishing you and your family a safe and enjoyable Labor Day weekend.

In case you're interested in some entertainment, I wanted to share two recent op-eds and several of the recent interviews on my SiriusXM weekly show that I think you will find interesting.

**Below you can find links to my recent conversations with:**
* **[General David Petraeus](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/GmlMPTqy0P8V1fHcls6lFmmODSM3JBzWMPXiWNMXAEJKhYtNahVuWPhDhvWUEi4NVINK8uN1MiyXpkYhu_Jt5gxeKNeapPRiLX_Bq7DVL3uX5UnuggRkY4BdbyZDom6smu-nnrRuJA_8iU8IZrVjijqeoJNdNcZ_9glBtO7JmOD5gGEUgh_WDio-W1RmZdYkIBchxXXEyueGtqPLJCauKFeQj3ICfI5EEytYxRVT8K2Lu1yjejbRc2LNI_XTJEfYjRDBT2OSF-udYqELA7smEZUUl6wrDXPnhEtwf_tR4n0leBbHz_hRSp4Cq_Xb2v9UfP3CI8SHDyjDoHR9SaQdDI0g_TB1rxTXTTWNhXs3I1M6weUL1XG_Hcid3eK5wLCT_rlBR68iB8ME/CZXV47gE53jPik0yoWNKJbdrQmWM0K0O/24):** Former CIA Director and retired Army General. We explored his personal story and discussed how drones and autonomous technology are changing modern warfare, and what that means for the United States.

* **[Chris Matthews](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/vYjbwgYhit0J5Uw-5tyn6RFV1y2ZEH8y7RFqSEgypA9WsoO4WmPwHvYi-eFLtBTxzwctsHtxHC8y3p1KvwZcPm4wgXpsH44fidsneEMXNqdAhrj5AaiacB93Tokn75eF4wboJ8dL7wWICngo8Gs5XXlWkaYZ0tuCrPZ77EsN8WsTGPHyKjltY7Wj68-_DPF3wrl3LwLX71c0dmo1oaCa1nr7LFmphN-u-VlWzL_TyPyMMhtmFMWrVyd4hQMv56Or5HU9XFvatKpnBsbsJN3O-Z7Vqw9J1Le890MM-Zz1DdbfaBUtETVZmw1oRaw2728-HoXqr6n7ceZJyIqFOrG8gdYYNohqpuwpm0bCFGnUc9bdwUC81nJCPx4E4PWWfUxKR2dVQOLIduZC/Ioqd5NaaiWHOM80ldf2aU1qO9IiAtfAf/24): **Veteran political commentator and longtime Hardball host. We discussed many topics, including whether the crazy amounts of money in politics are keeping us from getting the best and most diverse leaders to represent us in Washington.

* **[Dan Abrams](http://links.johnkasich.com/s/c/4JQIV5YMrSmTS7e_HL3azJiJFPo14jbW0M7BRaLKncXggjk4tZL5Lwvm3x1i3g_WfcCjCtMauRH8GcBItdqekLTp-GwHOkb7EXWrrBPftMR2_BuGeViIicpeGEhJqKlpm16UViQgpxUBYG5vPYMjeVpy9n8yT93xycUCWJVnDvwn4TNefvpbMxPS_LdH5V_UtQwueeQoGhIEqA04XcHCvbDFEEssBmFz36gCaHnvA9e4QftLJDtpqhYvHRTE06NykZaSphx1onfdovPc_R1tg37-HhT0_8yAhX9uYzQwVbnY9WdR7KcfUhaNWDr8Hfe6Ck5ij60py8TIjVRz6ydGoI8lv9sr31a_-MpcFfOiO-QXvm_PgZG6Fvn139LmTVqZd2mGMhw6aqVp/Wxz-eBM0NMNm81uRAP0bKj1_Zt-OuC-L/24):** American media entrepreneur, television host, and author. | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. [**Will you help Sgt. Duran fight for his freedom?**](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=91c08c1a28d8445ea6a26bd16629735b&_e=fUgMQ7EwwwjNg5KmYvRxq4DYG0OYse_84T3rrsgoDL5-A3NUCQjdNZlRaUCbP9HPt3QC0U6-cHHuD09NkWnaPEwrWy46NFVleaWIGBUOIhbDDCAXVKCkYE3BrcLbVEuGXNsjvFyvo0NHvTYVPVF0rtpBbpsSIxtfFJ4IRcMPrC3hY8LrvE5rDfdSV8rFY6-ID_yf969QedA6IvrCXF3eoG9PnufQzTNiuYuigG_mMDk_AuuI06VcLuINXNJxB1tKNysVcE29YLEKB36Kl5kOnSnfYKaVTpeuOLjgzH2KtESEmyX3mbKBLSY8aki0yUV6r12uNY_8I0pb_sWc2MHrRr8NYUagNwaKNZoEca1pQ1_A1AB0JAGuUuam_XDw66jIww8D9i27fUACOR5Iy9SxNcBFD4Ix15Nc8Dy-ijSdaFMoLN5bsieNn9cnE40yh5nNO2UuC7zKkECHb_qE03bGH4F5skurqs6h6eTK4cQG3Fc4_6wGkbp_Wgarfc67OFuy3RMzj6KfNaOieUS3AB53RQT5rGIWKv2159GoejrLSS9I0bd6r2JjXfBCoj0-A3GaKiDcQQ_T3D6UcSyuuruzOOesfsv6hpzz7By0PKX6WzYroXcuDjxXh4UceqpI7fbTMReWLngTosSYl5scDHAW7d9a5XUEoruJtf-rqrao_TU%3D) The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. clean_body: Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Fellow American, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom - All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They 're not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison. Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I'm asking for your help today. Erik spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! | | | | ---|---|---|--- (C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 Click |

clean_body: | = Peter, I have a big update: September 7 marks one of our biggest fundraising deadlines of the general election, and we set an ambitious goal of raising $100,000 to make sure we have the resources to win this race. Republicans have already poured in millions to flip this seat, and the latest polling makes clear that we can’t take anything for granted. The Albuquerque Journal called our margin “closer-than-expected.” My Republican opponent is already pointing to that poll as proof that this is a competitive race he can win. = | = Peter, this deadline isn’t just about hitting a number. It’s about what we’re able to do in the final eight weeks of this race, and what’s at stake for New Mexico if we come up short. I’m running for governor to put money back in New Mexicans’ pockets, make sure our kids get the education they deserve, protect access to affordable healthcare in every community, and make New Mexico a place where families can get ahead. My Republican opponent has a very different vision. He’s ready to cut Medicaid, SNAP, and the critical programs New Mexicans depend on. We can’t let that happen. That’s why this deadline matters so much. Every dollar we raise now gives us more resources to knock doors, organize communities, keep our message on the air, and reach the voters who will decide this election. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you in advance for stepping up today. We’ve gotten this far because people like you believe in what we can accomplish together, and I’m grateful to have you with me in this fight. | | | | Hey Fellow American, I was just on Meet the Press.... Kristen Welker asked me about 2028. About whether I'm going to run for president again. I have been on the road. I have been in the arena. My ideas for reform
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2501%2E135344%2EI_15xD)

Now is the time to clean up the Supreme Court and boldly reform it.
Last week I shared my ideas to clean up the Supreme Court so they can get back to being actual jurists -- one that would get us back to some sense of normalcy where there are vacancies for each President to fill, instead of these Justices gaming it to benefit their political party.
1\. You get 18 years on the court, OR
2\. You hit an age of 75 years old.
The first one of those two that hit and you're out.
**[Please watch this short video - 45 seconds - to learn more about my plan and what it'd mean for the country. And while you're there, please subscribe to my YouTube channel.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4453?t=2&akid=2501%2E135344%2EI_15xD)**
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/4453?t=3&akid=2501%2E135344%2EI_15xD)
The lifetime appointment is a relic of a bygone era in our country. I hope you agree.
Elissa Slotkin

As one of the few Senators who won a Senate race in the same state won by Trump, Elissa Slotkin is being asked to campaign for other Democrats in tough races across the country this election.

| | | I just got back from Ukraine.
I’m one of a small handful of Members of Congress to travel there in the past year — and I need to tell you what I saw, and why it matters so much to this fight.
For over four years, Ukraine has been fighting for its survival against Vladimir Putin's unprovoked invasion. I've stood with them since day one. I've led bipartisan legislation to arm Ukraine's military. I've fought to hold Russia accountable for war crimes. I've warned, again and again, that appeasing Putin doesn't bring peace — it invites the next invasion.
**Here's what I saw on this trip: A country still fighting, still resilient, still holding the line — and increasingly uncertain about whether America is still standing 100% behind them.**
That uncertainty didn't come from nowhere. Donald Trump has spent his presidency squeezing Ukraine while handing Vladimir Putin exactly what he wants. **I didn't take this trip for a photo opportunity. I took it because Ukraine needs to know that not every American leader has abandoned them — and because I wanted to see, firsthand, what's actually at stake in Ukraine.**
This is exactly why Equal Opportunity Now exists. We need Democrats in office who understand that standing up to authoritarian aggression isn't optional — it's central to who we are as a country. MAGA Republicans cannot be trusted with this. Time and again, they have shown they'll trade away our allies' security for a photo op with a dictator.
